title: Product Safety Manager
description:
**Job Description**
===================

**Job Title:** Product Safety Manager

**Working location:** India, Pune

**Years of Experience:** 5 to 10 years

  
  

**Why Rolls-Royce?**

At Rolls-Royce we are proud to be a business that has truly helped to shape the modern world and are committed to always being a force for progress; powering, protecting and connecting people everywhere.

By joining Rolls-Royce, you'll have the opportunity to work on world-class solutions, supported by a culture that believes individuality is our greatest strength, and all perspectives, experiences and backgrounds help us innovate and enable our high-performance culture.

  
  

**Summary:**

As a Project Safety Engineer, you will develop and maintain the Safety Cases for Project System Business to ensure the design and implementation at site is single fault tolerant and meets the Genset System functional hazard rates and all applicable certification requirements. You will be responsible for providing technical guidance, counsel, and direction to project team engineers to ensure technical outcomes are delivered to appropriate standards and quality. You will be responsible for the management of product safety in a project, from the concept phase to the end of the project and has operational tasks in the process.

In this role, you will have the opportunity to travel up to 20%.

  
  

**What you will be doing:**

With this attractive opportunity you will get a chance to:

* Collaborate with other teams and customers to select, define, apply, and moderate suitable methods (investigation of hazards, Hazard and Risk Analysis, determination of necessary risk reduction, FMEA, fault tree analysis, suitability analysis, etc.).
* Work with a cross-functional team to establish the highest standards of technical capability, quality, professionalism, and teamwork.
* Provide and support engineering and process guidance, training and create documentation.
* Prepare and review engineering work products for technical documentation, quality, completeness.
* Resolve complex problems through the application of acquired technical experience and knowledge.
* Develop and communicate complex technical ideas and information in a concise and logical way.
* Creates and maintains the project/order-specific safety plan based on the safety life cycle with application-specific enhancements and/or tailoring.
* Plans and executes the assessment in all phases of the safety life cycle, taking the required level of independence into account.
* Is responsible for Safety Management Plan (SMP) and execution.
* Defines documentation structure and requirements on document quality.
* Specifies requirements pertaining to safety functions and their integrity.
* Tracks actions and, if necessary, triggers a return to a suitable point in the product life cycle and safety life cycle in the case of changes.
* Assesses the personnel resources used with regards to appropriate competence.
* Defines safety specifications for the use, integration, operation, and maintenance as well as decommissioning and disposal of the scope of delivery (customer documentation, customer training).
* Acts as an interface with approval authorities and safety monitoring bodies.
* Integrates suppliers and service providers into the product safety management system.
* Provides project coaching on all product safety topics.
* Prepares safety reports.
* Communicates the safety strategy within the project organization ("culture of safe working").
* Has an interface function with regards to functional safety officers of the customer and supplier.
* Executes, commissions, and evaluates reviews and audits on product safety in the project.
* Keeps proof of safety records for the project.
* Takes part in the preparation of declarations of incorporation if the EC Machinery Directive is applied.
* Helps to improve and further develop the product safety concept.
* Regularly prepares reports and, if necessary, escalates issues to the project manager, strategic product safety management and – if available – to the project safety coordinator.
* Selects aids and tools to use in the development of safety-related products.
* Cooperates in the qualification of development environments.
* Ensures conformity of project/order-specific product safety management with the organization wide safety life cycle.
* Escalates in case of deviations from the organization-wide safety life cycle and the infringement of the strategy for product safety in the project.
* Escalates in the case of product safety risks which cannot be tolerated.
* Applies the safety life cycle in the project, including activities to carry out and work products to be created.
* Takes measures for avoiding and overcoming systematic and occasional errors.
* Releases next safety life cycle phase.
* Approves or rejects change requirements with an impact on product safety.
* Takes correction measures for fulfilling the safety life cycle in the project.
* Right to report on strategic product safety management and product safety coordinator. Skills, knowledge, and constraints.

**Tendering Matters:**

* Work closely with the regional team to define the technical scope.
* Review/clarify customer’s specifications & tender documents.
* Review and finalize the C/D/E document together with the regional application engineering team.
* Provide the technical specifications and define the scope of supply for the equipment.
* Coordinate with factory and local suppliers to harmonize the scope of supply.

**Solution Engineering Matters:**

* Ensure all electrical designs and installations comply with relevant industry standards, codes, and regulations.
* Define the electrical systems requirements for the walk in genset enclosures suitable for the project needs.
* Support the execution team to resolve technical issue related to the Electrical systems during project execution, from packaging to site related.
* Participate in design review and lessons learnt sessions. Proactively provide valuable insights and recommendation to enhance system performance and efficiency.
  

  

**Basic Requirements:**

* Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering with 5+ years of product development engineering experience in Genset, Alternator, Electrical Panels (Switchgear, Transformer, NGR, GCB, EPMS, Busduct, Cables, Controls).
* Safety Management System Knowledge and Experience.
* Added Advantage- Safexpert Tool and PTC Integrity -RV&S9.

**Preferred Requirements:**

* 5+ years of product safety engineering experience.
* Application of agile development methods to deliver engineering work products.
* Familiarity with the following standards: ISO-8528, CPCB Norms, OSHA, OSH Code 2020 .
* Decision-making competence.
* Extensive knowledge of the legal framework of safety provisions and the relevant product safety standards.
* Experience of the most important safety analysis techniques.
* Power of persuasion.
* Detailed knowledge of the safety life cycle.
* Detailed knowledge of the order handling and/or development processes.
* Knowledge of the application area.
* Extensive knowledge about the system to be delivered and the system context.
* Knowledge of the effects of the failure of the safety-related systems.
* Solid understanding of automation system, electrical system, protection system of a diesel generator set and demonstrate the ability to integrate the understanding into designing a genset enclosure.
  

  
  

Power Systems is the Rolls-Royce business which provides world-class power solutions and complete life-cycle support under our product and solution brand *mtu* . Through digitalisation and electrification, we strive to develop drive and power generation solutions that provide answers to the challenges posed by the rapidly growing societal demands for energy and mobility.

We deliver and service comprehensive, powerful and reliable systems, based on both gas and diesel engines, as well as electrified hybrid systems. These technologically advanced solutions serve our customers in the marine and infrastructure sectors worldwide.

  
  

Our vision is to ensure that the excellence and ingenuity that shaped our history continues into our future. Our multi-year transformation programme aims to turn Rolls-Royce into a high-performing, competitive, resilient and growing company. Join us, and it can be your future vision too.

Rolls-Royce are committed to being a respectful, inclusive, and non-discriminatory workplace where individuality is valued, diverse perspectives fuel innovation, and everyone can thrive.

  

**Type of Contract**
====================

Permanent

title: Senior Manager, IT Program Management
description:
Innovation starts from the heart. At Edwards Lifesciences, we're dedicated to developing ground\-breaking technologies with a genuine impact on patients' lives. At the core of this commitment is our investment in cutting\-edge information technology. This supports our innovation and collaboration on a global scale, enabling our diverse teams to optimize both efficiency and success. As part of our IT team, your expertise and commitment will help facilitate our patient\-focused mission by developing and enhancing technological solutions.


The Anaplan Center of Excellence ( CoE ) owns a portfolio of 50\+ connected planning applications used across Finance, Commercial, and Operations. As Sr. Project Manager, you will orchestrate the delivery of new applications and the continuous enhancement of the existing portfolio, working with a globally distributed team of developers and administrators and with business partners across multiple functions and time zones.


**How** **you'll** **make an impact:**

* Orchestrate a portfolio of concurrent Anaplan initiatives – new application builds and enhancement/update releases – across multiple use case families (e.g., financial planning \& analysis, commercial and sales planning, operational planning), balancing priorities, dependencies, and shared resources across 50\+ applications.
* Lead end\-to\-end delivery: intake and business case, detailed requirements definition, scoping, planning, build coordination, testing/UAT, deployment, and hypercare , using a hybrid delivery methodology (Agile sprints for build, stage\-gate/Waterfall controls for planning and release).
* Coordinate day\-to\-day delivery of a distributed CoE team – 8–11 Anaplan developers in Pune and administrator resources in Prague and the US – without direct people\-management responsibility: plan sprints and releases, remove blockers, manage capacity and sequencing across projects.
* Partner with the enterprise data team on data integration requirements, source availability, and interface timelines; align delivery plans with data pipeline readiness.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with finance partners, commercial stakeholders, and other business functions; manage expectations, translate business priorities into a realistic delivery roadmap, and communicate status, risks, and trade\-offs transparently.
* Maintain the CoE delivery roadmap and release calendar; manage changes to scope, schedule, and cost so plans remain accurate and reflect authorized changes.
* Actively manage project risks and issues; monitor performance, identify and quantify variances, and drive corrective actions.
* Facilitate creation and approval of business cases and prioritization decisions, using historical data and expert judgment to understand constraints.
* Strengthen CoE delivery governance: standardize intake, estimation, status reporting, and release management practices; lead continuous improvement of PM processes within the CoE .
* Manage project closure activities, including lessons learned, and drive resulting improvements into future releases.
* Serve as a project management subject matter expert within the CoE ; guide and mentor team members on delivery practices.
* Other incidental duties.
**What** **you'll** **need (Required):**

* Bachelor's Degree in a related field.
* A minimum of eight years of hands\-on experience managing software delivery projects of increasing complexity, or equivalent work experience based on Edwards criteria.
* Project Management Professional (PMP); if not, Green Belt, Black Belt, or Scrum Master certification.
* Demonstrated experience managing delivery with globally distributed teams and cross\-functional business stakeholders.
* Experience running hybrid delivery models (Agile/Scrum combined with Waterfall/stage\-gate governance).
* This role is not a remote position. It requires onsite presence at the Edwards IT Innovation Hub in Pune, India, working second shift with overlap to European (CET) and partial US working hours.
**What else we look for (Preferred):**

* Experience delivering Enterprise Performance Management (EPM) / connected planning implementations on any platform (e.g., Anaplan, Oracle Hyperion/EPM Cloud, SAP Analytics Cloud/BPC, OneStream, Workday Adaptive Planning, Pigment).
* Understanding of planning processes in finance (budgeting, forecasting, long\-range planning) and/or commercial functions (sales forecasting, quota and territory planning).
* Experience working alongside data engineering teams on integrations (ETL/ELT, APIs, data hubs).
* Demonstrated experience with SDLC project management methodologies (Waterfall, Agile, DevOps) and tools (e.g., Jira, Azure DevOps, Smartsheet).
* Proven expertise in MS Office Suite and related project management systems.
* Excellent documentation, communication, and interpersonal skills, including negotiation and relationship management, with the ability to drive achievement of objectives .
* Excellent problem\-solving, organizational, analytical, and critical thinking skills.
* Excellent understanding of and work experience with project budgets and financial management .
* Experience in life sciences, medical devices, or another regulated industry.

### **Job Details**

* Participate in infrastructure automation initiatives using PowerShell, Python, Bash, or similar scripting technologies.
* Collaborate with Infrastructure, Network, Security, Storage, and Application teams on production support, planned maintenance, infrastructure projects, and operational improvements.

* Prepare operational documentation, support internal/external audits, and continuously identify opportunities for automation and operational efficiency
  

  

**Required Skills**

  

  

* Proven hands\-on experience in IBM i (AS400/iSeries) Administration within enterprise production environments.
* Proven experience with IBM Program Temporary Fixes (PTFs), HMC, LPAR Administration, BRMS, IBM i Security Administration, User Profile Management, High Availability/Disaster Recovery (MIMIX/PowerHA or equivalent), Automic, CL (Control Language), Query/400, SQL Principles, DB2, FTP/SFTP, TCP/IP, IBM MQ, Client Access (iSeries Access), and SOX Compliance.

* Experience working within ITIL\-based production support environments covering Incident, Change, and Problem Management.

* Experience with PowerShell, Python, Bash, or similar scripting technologies for automation and operational efficiency.
  

  

  

**Preferred Skills**

  

  

* Demonstrated experience supporting enterprise infrastructure across multiple technology domains in addition to IBM i.
* Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, Dell PowerEdge Platforms, SAN/NAS Storage.
* VMware vSphere Administration.
* Azure and/or AWS infrastructure administration.
* Infrastructure automation using PowerShell, Python, Ansible, or similar tools.
* Monitoring tools such as SolarWinds, Nagios, PRTG, or equivalent.
* JDE World, JDE OneWorld, Hawkeye, DBU, Crystal Reports.
  

  

**Experience**

  

  

  

* **4\+ years of proven hands\-on experience supporting IBM i (AS400/iSeries) operating systems in enterprise production environments.**
* 2\+ years of demonstrated production support experience in one or more of the following areas: Microsoft Azure (preferred), AWS, Windows Server, Linux, VMware, Enterprise Storage, or Backup technologies.
* Candidates should be able to demonstrate real\-world implementation, administration, troubleshooting, and production support experience across the technologies listed above during technical interviews.
